Hi Bornhorst + Ward team,

I'm applying for your Graduate Program, which I found on your careers page.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, and I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your page says graduates get real project work and a mentor from day one, which is the kind of start I am looking for after my site years and my design course. My degree is from the Philippines rather than an Australian university, and I am open to discussing relocation to Brisbane or working from your Melbourne office.

Would you be open to a short call about the program? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,

paragraphs: I am applying for the Bornhorst + Ward Graduate Program. Your careers page says graduates are given responsibility on real projects with an experienced mentor, and that is the start I want for my civil engineering career in Australia.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines, and in February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia. My course covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and I prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D to Australian Standards.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines, first as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and then as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against the work, carried out site inspections and quality checks, and prepared site reports and progress records.

I hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I live in Melton and am open to discussing relocation to Brisbane or a place in your Melbourne office. My degree is from the Philippines rather than an Australian university, and I am keen to learn from your engineers.
Thank you for considering my application. Some of my course drawings are at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.
